steps.en: Frontend NOPOs get the contact check, like every other notice
steps.id: NOPO frontend ikut pengecekan kontak, sama seperti notice lain
steps.why_en: The check is not limited to frontend notices; the code never looks at the source.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan tidak dibatasi untuk notice frontend; code tidak melihat sumbernya.

steps.en: Individual owners' latest mobile number is fetched and saved
steps.id: Nomor mobile terbaru pemilik individu diambil dan disimpan

steps.en: Company owners' latest email address is fetched and saved
steps.id: Email terbaru pemilik company diambil dan disimpan

steps.en: A fresh contact check just before sending is built but switched off
steps.id: Pengecekan kontak segar tepat sebelum kirim sudah dibuat tapi dimatikan
steps.why_en: The refresh code exists, but it is switched off in every environment.
steps.why_id: Code refresh ada, tetapi dimatikan di semua environment.

steps.en: The notice screen shows where the contact came from
steps.id: Layar notice menunjukkan dari mana kontak berasal
steps.why_en: Nothing stores or shows where a mobile or email came from.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang menyimpan atau menampilkan asal nomor mobile atau email.
